summary: Velora Dry Fruits — first formal test pass. Backend (17/17 pytest pass) and frontend critical flows verified: home with all sections, cart add/qty/remove/subtotal/WA checkout, localStorage persistence, PDP /product/mamra-almond with qty + Add + Buy Now + WhatsApp + floating WA button, newsletter subscribe (+ success state + dedupe), admin login (wrong/right token), search, refresh, logout, festive banner rotation, mobile responsive (390px). WhatsApp number 9739323112 and links present on header, hero, PDP, cart, floating button.

issues: Sonner toast positioned near top-center renders directly over the sticky header navigation links (Home/Shop/Offers/...) on desktop — slight overlap, links momentarily covered while toast is visible. Consider top-right or below-header offset.

observations: Featured products renders 8 bestsellers (correct). On the home page only 32 product cards are visible by default (8 featured + 24 in catalog grid). The dataset contains all 106 products (verified in /app/frontend/src/data/products.js). If the requirement is to show ALL 106 on home, the catalog component appears to either paginate or filter. Manual scroll/category-tab interaction was not exhaustively explored. Main agent should confirm whether catalog 'Load more' or category filters expose all 106 — if not, that's a gap.

Newsletter has a graceful localStorage fallback when API fails: this masks real backend errors and always shows success. Acceptable UX but the success-state would also fire if backend returns 5xx (not currently happening, but worth noting).
Admin delete uses window.confirm() (not a styled dialog) — works but slightly inconsistent with the luxury design language.

Static image route /api/static/products/<slug>.png works (verified ajwa-dates.png 200, content-type image/*). The filename 'velora-ecommerce.png' mentioned in the review request does NOT exist on disk — actual file names are per-product slugs (e.g., almond-jumbo.png).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is small and clean. Uses MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from env, excludes _id from Mongo queries, validates EmailStr, returns 401 for admin failures, 404 for missing subscriber — all correct.
Newsletter dedupe by lowercased email works as designed.
CartContext correctly persists to localStorage key 'velora_cart_v1' and de-duplicates by slug while incrementing qty.
All product cards, PDP, header, admin have proper data-testid coverage — excellent testability.
action_items: (Optional) Confirm whether home-page catalog should display all 106 products vs current 24 visible — add 'Load more' or verify category-filter UX.
(Optional) Adjust Sonner toast position so it does not overlap the sticky desktop nav.
(Nice-to-have) Replace window.confirm() in Admin delete with a styled AlertDialog for design consistency.
seed_data_creation: Tests create/cleanup subscribers with @velora-test.com suffix. Cleanup test removes them after the suite.

rca_of_the_issue: No bugs requiring RCA found in this iteration.
